headline: Indian IT services showed uneven growth with AI driving strong gains for some firms while others lagged.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from modest single‑digit to over 50% YoY. AI‑related revenue and deal wins were highlighted by several companies, boosting margins for leaders. Guidance was trimmed by Infosys and introduced by HCLTech and Wipro, indicating cautious outlook. Profit trends were mixed, with some firms posting double‑digit jumps and others seeing declines.

themes.title: AI‑led growth
themes.detail: Companies such as Coforge, Mphasis and HCLTech cited AI revenue surges and AI‑driven pipelines as key contributors.

themes.title: Revenue guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and HCLTech introduced a modest 2.5‑4% range.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance.
13.6% YoY revenue growth with strong AI‑led services.
15.6% YoY revenue growth and solid profit expansion.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and profit growth modest.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9%.
Revenue up 30% YoY but profit dropped 25% YoY.
